draft.inside_message: Happy birthday, Mum. The watercolours are genuinely good, whatever you say about them, so please stop apologising for the ones you show me. Have a lovely day, and I'll speak to you Sunday at six as usual.

artwork_brief.style_note: loose watercolour-style confetti, soft edges, lots of white space

draft.rationale: Leans on the new watercolours and the Sunday six o'clock call for warmth and specificity, in a light, son-to-mum voice with no mention of age.
